grader.scenario: Full fibre external wall box (CSP) broken by delivery van; resolved via emergency same-day dispatch and instant unlimited mobile data
grader.notes: Flawless emergency infrastructure call demonstrating deep empathy in the middle third, immediate emergency mobile data provision, harmless recheck in the final third, and complete resolution.

items.name: Branding and Survey Check
items.evidence: Agent opened with 'Thank you for calling S-Net full fibre infrastructure support' at [00:00] and closed with 'Thank you for choosing S-Net' in final lines.

items.name: Hold time and Dead Air
items.evidence: Hold was announced with could I place you on hold and thanked upon return without unmanaged dead air.

items.name: Verified customer
items.evidence: Verified full postal address and security PIN within the first 240 seconds.

items.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
items.evidence: Agent addressed customer as Patrick throughout the call.

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: Agent demonstrated exceptional empathy at turn 22 ('I completely understand the sheer panic and intense pressure this has put on your architectural practice, Patrick...') and customer had no unhandled outbursts.

items.name: Paraphrasing
items.evidence: Agent accurately paraphrased the vehicle impact and severed fiber cable issue at turn 2.

items.name: Active listening
items.evidence: Agent completed harmless recheck of customer address at turn 42.

items.name: Took ownership of the problem
items.evidence: Agent arranged emergency same-day dispatch, waived fees, provisioned unlimited emergency mobile data, and sent live engineer tracking.

items.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
items.evidence: Agent maintained an exemplary, comforting, and highly professional demeanor throughout.

items.name: Probing
items.evidence: Agent probed about safety hazards, vehicle plates, and upload deadlines.

items.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
items.evidence: Customer connected to emergency mobile hotspot, verified CAD blueprint upload at 60 Mbps, and confirmed engineer 15 minutes away.
